name: SIDDAVATAM VISHNAVI
title: AI Engineer
tagline: Building AI-powered solutions and intelligent applications.
bio:
I'm a Computer Science and Engineering graduate with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Python Development, and Full Stack Development. I have hands-on experience building intelligent applications using Python, FastAPI, React.js, MySQL, REST APIs, and modern web technologies.

During my Full Stack Development training at Ojasa Mirai, I worked on developing and integrating frontend, backend, and database components to build practical web applications. I gained experience in API development, database management, Git, GitHub, and application deployment workflows.

My projects include AI Wellness Coach, an AI-powered wellness application that provides personalized yogasana recommendations, and an AI Speech-Based Depression & Anxiety Screening system that applies speech processing and machine learning techniques for screening support. I am passionate about leveraging Python, Full Stack Development, and Generative AI to create innovative solutions that address real-world challenges.
